dict.string: Mirona transcribes your side of the call on this Mac. Audio never leaves your computer unless you choose a cloud model.
Mirona records the other side of the call from your Mac's system audio and transcribes it on this Mac. Audio never leaves your computer unless you choose a cloud model.
Mirona names a call after the calendar event happening now, when you turn this on in Settings. Your calendar never leaves your computer.
